description: This file defines the EncounterType class, which models different types of Encounter objects within the OpenMRS medical records system. It includes properties such as encounterTypeId, viewPrivilege, and editPrivilege, along with associated constructors, getters, and setters. The class extends BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata and is annotated with @Audited for audit logging.

classes.name: EncounterType
classes.description: This class models encounter types within the OpenMRS system, allowing for categorization and privilege management for viewing and editing encounters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the getId method to return the encounter type ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the setId method to set the encounter type ID.

methods.name: getViewPrivilege
methods.description: Retrieves the privilege required to view this encounter type.

methods.name: setViewPrivilege
methods.description: Sets the privilege required to view this encounter type.

methods.name: getEditPrivilege
methods.description: Retrieves the privilege required to edit this encounter type.

methods.name: setEditPrivilege
methods.description: Sets the privilege required to edit this encounter type.
